notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update (Extra Vulnerable Edition)
notes.content:
Big news to celebrate Wild Honesty's 1yr anniversary! Thank you all for sticking with us this long! 9/30/21 will be our first birthday!

First up: the game is 40% off through Sunday night (10/3/21) - our biggest sale ever. If you have friends who haven't bought it yet that might like it, we're celebrating, so now is the time!

Second: As a treat for our deepest fans, the Extra Vulnerable Pack is now released! Our lead question writer Kalina Silverman said that this was the first time she really felt that she didn't have to hold anything back - and I can confirm it. I'm really excited about this one, and I think you'll like it.

Third: Long overdue, we missed one of our intended question packs back in April of this year, and are finally releasing the Spring Pack to make the 1yr anniversary a double update. We've got questions about growth, nature, and wildlife in a number of ways. If you like the outdoors, it's a solid pack for that.

And fourth as always: twice as many new animals are added this time, for a whopping 40 additions. We now have 1,000+ questions total, 12 bonus question packs, and 250+ animals. We only launched with around 10% of this, so it's been a privilege getting to build it out with you all over the last year.

Just on a personal note - I want to thank you all for giving Wild Honesty such a chance. The idea of an emotionally vulnerable party game sends some folks running, but the fans we have are so inspiring, it keeps morale high. You all have been an honor to make this game for, and I feel lucky that together we've been able bring this to the world.

And please check the credits and give a shoutout to the rest of our team too - they've all been working nonstop on all this. Kalina, Rachel, Andy, Allison, Dana, and everyone at Tubik have all been working hard on a near weekly basis here - not to mention all who came before them. It's been a huge group effort, and I'm so proud of how many talented folks I've been lucky enough to work with along the way.

Thank you all! It's been an honor so far, and I can't wait for what comes next!

Sincerely,
Brian

notes.title: Back to School Update
notes.content:
Introducing the "Back to School" pack! With 80 new questions about academia, the formal and informal teachers in our lives, and what it means to learn and grow - you'll quickly get a sense for how education plays a role in the lives of your fellow players.

Long requested: a "Questions Only" option has been added too! In Settings, you can now choose an "Animals Off" state to play with only questions. Players who wish to keep diving into conversations without guessing games can settle into more serious, focused gameplay with no palette cleansers inbetween. We do not recommend this mode for first time players! The guessing game helps with the emotional weight of the subject matters, but we are introducing this experimental mode at players' requests. Please do give us feedback though if you do use it - that will help us refine it even more!

Minor fixes include slightly improved 4k screen support, better fullscreen and windowed hotkey and multi-monitor switching support, and very slight UI fixes for keyboard/controller navigation.

Thanks for playing, all! We should have something special to celebrate our 1yr anniversary near the end of this month!

notes.title: National History Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mUMrIW4TE3o;full][/previewyoutube]
This pack makes significant changes to the final question in each round. Now tied to vulnerability level, finale questions will be better suited for any session's chosen friendship level. This will lead to better connections, more fulfilling conclusions, and uniquely suited prompts for every set of friends. This has been applied to all past question packs now, as well as all future ones.

We also released the National game pack! It focuses on political history, national culture, and how land and ethnicity overlap with that. Expect to be challenged as you answer prompts about what our nations, their histories, and futures mean to you. 

More animals are also joining the mix, but we figure the question changes and new questions matter most.

One more small update is that we've reduced the game size by almost 50% with improved video codecs! This should help us have space to keep adding more updates without becoming a large burden on anyone's computers.

Enjoy, and thank you for staying with us all these months! We have some big news coming soon!

notes.title: Summer Vacation Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=K97eNb_dOMk;full][/previewyoutube]
This month, we're presenting a smaller content-only update to ensure we have a new pack in time for the US and Canadian holidays. The questions for this holiday weekend are about travel, vacation, and plenty of summer memories. Did you ever have a summer flirt? How was your last summer job? Were any childhood friendships formed forever from just one summer?

In addition to these 60 new questions: there's a whole new set of animals to join too!

This update is brief, since it's just the content pack, but we wanted to make sure it got out on time even so. Enjoy though, and let us know your thoughts! We're starting to look into more gameplay options based on the comments in the Steam discussion forum, so please keep the feedback coming. It helps us a lot. 

Happy summer, all!

notes.title: Spiritual Reflection Update
notes.content:
We're back with a slightly bigger update, and to start things off: the Spiritual Reflection pack is here! These 50 new questions cover the wide range of spiritual development that lead so many to choose a life of spirituality, atheism, religion, or somewhere in-between. We end one of the most spiritual times of the year by asking the big questions about life, what exists beyond us, and why we believe what we do.

Since the wait was so long since our last update too, we've nearly doubled the number of new animals to join as well, including going back to add extra animals to the Family History pack to make it more ancestral (with a wide range of our nearest Monkey/Ape animal kingdom neighbors) as well as tweaking our Romance pack to be more avian focused with bird songs. 

The last major change today is on representation: the stock footage in our initial game pack was largely composed of only white folks, and did not reflect the diversity of either the world or our player base. So today's update goes back and adds a wider diversity of faces to our original pack's footage, which you'll see both in-game and in the game's conclusion videos. Representation matters, and we want to do our part to improve the state of the world on this too.

We'd like this month especially to give a special thanks to all the fans who have supported us so far in all these updates and releases. We have plenty more to come, and are looking forward to sharing more soon. Keep an eye out here for more updates, more consistently, shortly! And until then, let us know what you think of the new pack, and we'll try and tackle a couple more bugs we see being voiced too.

notes.title: Irish Luck Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TIA3M2pEJvY;full][/previewyoutube]
The Family History Pack has arrived! We have another 50 new questions and some new animals for the back to back heritage focus of both Black History month having just ended, and St. Patrick's Irish heritage day being only last week. This pack puts a special focus on asking harder questions about family and our ancestries, and went through multiple reviews with diversity oversight to ensure all content was respectful and careful in these regards.

We also have our first sale, to celebrate six months since release! Thank you all so much for the support up until now. This game has always been a dream to create, and it's wonderful to be able to share the experience with so many of you.

There are no bugfixes to accompany this month's content pack, but things are looking up for a wave of new improvements later this year. Keep an eye out, and we hope you continue to enjoy the new content until then!

notes.title: Rose Garden Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zBQ6GCcU4Pc;full][/previewyoutube]
The Romance Game Pack has arrived! Go on a cute bird watching visit among flowery decorations, and answer questions about love, romance, and dating. We have 50 new questions and a handful of new feathery creatures to join.

Minor bugfixes have also been added for decorations on switching game packs, and some backend work too.

Thank you for being patient as this update arrives a bit later than usual! We hope to be back on a more consistent schedule soon. And thank you all for the feedback, even if we can't fix every bug quite yet! It all helps.

notes.title: Lunar New Year Update
notes.content:
The New Year Game Pack is now released, for a dedicated Time, Celebration, and Life gameplay mode! All twelve zodiac animals have now been added, alongside 50 new year's themed questions. 

The prompts for this pack are around:

Favorite parties with family or friends
Reflecting on life and cherishing each year
Making plans for a brighter future

This is also the year of the Ox, which is supposed to be a symbol of spiritual strength. We think this question pack might be able to help cultivate that too!

notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.content:
Happy new year, all! Mostly a minor update here, but we've made a fix to restore the Winter Holiday pack functionality that 4k screen users had trouble with last update. Let us know in the comments if it, and room codes, are working once more for you!

This update also brings Wild Honesty up to 100 animals total! That's nearly 2.5x as many as we launched with, so we're proud to reach that milestone. We are looking for feedback on how folks are enjoying the additional content too, as we want to figure out in the new year what parts of the updates fans are getting the most of out of (and where to put our resources more!)

We've also added a few bubbly and sparkly - or implied sparkly - decorations to the main screen to celebrate the new year. Keep your eyes peeled for another question pack coming shortly! After all, Lunar New Year is just around the corner...

notes.title: Winter Holiday Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=msyMgbmgQD0;full][/previewyoutube]
A jolly old man in a red hat accidentally mixed the coal in with the gifts this year - we've got a whole new question pack filled with equal parts hard and fun questions about the holidays! This question pack's themes are Gifts, Loved Ones, and Winter. Joining too are another ten animals, mostly with a thick layer of fur to keep out the cold, and a new in-game news feature to let you know any time we release new free content or if the servers go down. We figure that's something worth alerting players of! But if that's a gift you don't want - just let us know in the Steam community discussion board. We only plan to use it about once a month for the new gameplay packs, and possibly server outages.

For now though - you've got another 50+ new questions to check out! And if you do try this pack for the any visits home or friendly gatherings, let us know how it went in the comments. We're always looking to improve!

Happy holidays!

notes.title: First Snowfall Update
notes.content:
Reconnecting to a game from a timed-out device is now the easiest it's ever been - as browsers will automatically search for your last game and (if it's still active) ask if you'd like to rejoin it directly. This small option for disconnected players gives them control here, while making it easier for players to reconnect.

We've also thrown in an elk, a beaver, a rabbit, and a few other familiar winter faces too! And you may notice an advent wreath counting down the days until our next seasonal pack is released. 

If you're looking for a little winter update for Wild Honesty in this festive season, this is it! And expect a bigger one later this month!

notes.title: Late Autumn Update
notes.content:
The Autumn Game Pack is now released, for a dedicated Fall, Food, and Family gameplay mode! A second round of ten Fall animals have also been added. This update comes with the ability to go back and play past seasonal question packs too, in case you missed them! You'll see a sparkle when new question packs have been added to the Seasonal Mode button, as we hope to continue releasing new question content, animals, and seasonal gameplay packs in the future. With 60 new autumn themed questions, this should warm your hearth while the cold spikes outdoors!

So snuggle up with some apple cider and a good sweater. This update is best played by your first fireplace use of the season...

notes.title: Early Fall Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ex3RpEgkzlQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Our latest update adds ten new animals and a couple requested features:
* Fullscreen toggle in settings
* Ultrawide and 4:3 screen ratio support
* Actual eagle sounds (no more falcons!)

A couple decorations line the edge of the menu for Fall now too! But you'll have to wait for our next update to see the question pack to match...

notes.title: Big Spooky Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qV0UwNYyNj8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Spooky Game Pack is now released, for a dedicated Halloween gameplay mode! A second round of ten Halloween animals join the mix too! This update comes with even better randomization of cards, designed specifically for multiple back-to-back rounds of gameplay, lots of new (slightly cursed) questions, and the Spooky Game Pack itself for dedicated Halloween gameplay - with 50 Halloween questions all its own. 

Don't be frightened. This update has lots of new fun scary little things to enjoy!

notes.title: Spooky Little Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tnybzWxoVs4;full][/previewyoutube]
The spooky season is here! Ten new animals have been added, mostly creepy crawlies like bats, crows, vultures, and ghosts! Seasonal decorations and networking fixes join too!

Technically this released on Friday, but we're a little late on our first Steam update post!
